app.title: Pg_vectorsearch: An index that is faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW
app.author: jascha_eng
app.description: PostgreSQL extension providing high-performance vector search index surpassing pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and build extension against PostgreSQL 15
Create test table, insert 10,000 random vectors
Run similarity query using Pg_vectorsearch index, measure latency
Compare query performance against pgvector's IVFFlat
